source_evidence: Fresh scoped check (request.json sha256 0ca2ad8a8ebf045d6d9557b3a0390180fae0a3dd0bace0f256ebb1a206bf25c4, exit 3, /diagnostics/check/report/candidate/checks/binary/functions) measures both affected entities as overall pass: ?enable_group@Wave_Device@@QAEHI@Z 0x004C53A0 (entity-9afb7d31156a27027b00eb06cd82c5d11b60725dd4dc903e64b1f29d45ee8671) and ?disable_group@Wave_Device@@QAEHI@Z 0x004C5400 (entity-7959a947680ff9c885749336bc4b2f9eacc8be122c6899999f719ca3dfbad09e); on the game-code flag set /c /O2 /Gy /GR- /Oy- /GX /Z7 both variants read bytes pass, references pass, differing_offsets [] over the full ORIGINAL spans 5002144-5002240 and 5002240-5002333 - the discovery's sole structural delta, the displaced push esi, no longer exists in the current spelling.

The insight is expressed in current source, not merely claimed: src/wave_device.cpp implements enable_group (ORIGINAL 0x004C53A0) and disable_group (ORIGINAL 0x004C5400) with the early-return-0 layout - range guard, enabled test and cursor walk at function level in sequence, enabled byte stored AFTER the walk - and the in-file LEVER notes document exactly this layout as what makes VC6 place push esi in the prologue (mov eax,[ebp+8]; push esi; cmp) with its pop inside the 0xA tail, the image's own placement. Both affected identities are inside this task's owned scope, so no expansion is needed before incorporation.

The worker's own 2026-09-18 decks (TRIED notes carried on both markers, mapped_records file_sha256 0e9a1cb2d68b32d5d2ad789db6b351c757a1bdb8ccb1eae0454008fcf045c566) measured this spelling BYTE-EXACT on /O2 /Oy- (0 of 96 and 0 of 93 differing, references resolved) and retain the measured-worse alternatives (body-in-if, goto body-label, hoisted nullptr first, hoisted group pointer, list-above-guard, hoisted enabled local) as history; the hypothesis's 'scheduler coin, no source lever' tail is superseded by the landed spelling itself, not by a passing checker.

Failure and unknown tails are preserved unchanged by this decision: obligation-level measurements count 35 pass / 2 unknown with the only unknowns obligation-1a95d92f38c3871e41d0efc616aeb2c249b4ef6c67cc8850c9cce6bdc1238412 (pull_from_group, unresolved ??3@YAXPAX@Z) and obligation-2d6deb41b43f3036a35fef3b25f95caa417e072a44d1c716b75a9827eb66227d (add_to_group, unresolved ?insert@WaveGroupList@@QAEXPAVWave@@@Z), the function-level fails set_hwnd/select and unknowns ??0/??1Wave_Device are untouched, and the non-Oy- variant rows for enable/disable still record the positional displacement as compiler-side diagnostics. This incorporation claims expression in source only - no binary or behavioral proof, no demoted claim, no baseline change - and the pending discoveries worker-4c4dfe577fb04bc1beaadbb3419cce2d and worker-0dc6e5263ca146fdb1f3b5639144ceb1 remain pending for separate decisions.
